summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting that it completed a Federal Dispute Resolution meeting with the FDA regarding its BLA for ONS-5010. The meeting follows a December 2025 Complete Response Letter. No deal terms or financial transactions are involved; this is a regulatory update. The company expects a formal FDA response in May 2026. This filing does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event; it is a routine current report on regulatory progress. No risk-arb angle applies.
